name: AI Slow-Mo
short: Slow motion from any clip, or smoother motion
description: Makes new frames between the real ones (frame interpolation with FILM, on this PC's GPU through ComfyUI). The clip, or the section you mark with In and Out, plays 2, 4 or 8 times slower, or at the same speed with 2 to 8 times the frame rate. Scene cuts are found first, so no frame is ever blended across a cut. Slow motion is silent; smoother motion keeps the sound.

model.label: a frame interpolation model (FILM or RIFE)

options.name: hfr
options.label: Smoother motion instead (the same speed, keeps the sound)

options.name: scene
options.label: Scene cut threshold
options.hint: Lower finds more cuts. No frame is ever blended across a cut.

options.name: compare
options.label: Side by side with the original
